newsitem.title: FRANCE: Deadline to submit SFP bids Sept 28 - sources.
newsitem.headline: Deadline to submit SFP bids Sept 28 - sources.

text.p: The French state has set a deadline of September 28 for submission of bids in the privatisation of film and television production company Societe Francaise de Production (SFP), sources close to the deal said on Friday.
Neither SFP nor Finance Ministry officials could be reached for comment.
Businessman Walter Butler is the only candidate to have publicly stated his interest in SFP.
Cie Generale des Eaux an important player in the French media industry, only said in August it did not exclude joining in a privatisation bid.
Cie Generale des Eaux may be supporting Butler's bid, sources said.

Belgian producer LBO Convoi is also interested in the privatisation and may be supported by media giant Havas, while a former SFP official may get help from Hachette of the Lagardere Groupe, they said.
But a Lagardere spokesman told Reuters Hachette was not supporting any bids for SFP.
An Havas spokesman declined to comment while Generale des Eaux officials could not be reached for comments.
